public final WritableRaster filter(final Raster pSource, WritableRaster pDest, IndexColorModel pColorModel) {
        int width = pSource.getWidth();
        int height = pSource.getHeight();

        // Create destination raster if needed
        if (pDest == null) {
            pDest = createCompatibleDestRaster(pSource, pColorModel);
        }

        // Initialize Floyd-Steinberg error vectors.
        // +2 to handle the previous pixel and next pixel case minimally
        // When reference for column, add 1 to reference as this buffer is
        // offset from actual column position by one to allow FS to not check
        // left/right edge conditions
        int[][] currErr = new int[width + 2][3];
        int[][] nextErr = new int[width + 2][3];

        // Random errors in [-1 .. 1] - for first row
        for (int i = 0; i < width + 2; i++) {
            // Note: This is broken for the strange cases where nextInt returns Integer.MIN_VALUE
            currErr[i][0] = RANDOM.nextInt(FS_SCALE * 2) - FS_SCALE;
            currErr[i][1] = RANDOM.nextInt(FS_SCALE * 2) - FS_SCALE;
            currErr[i][2] = RANDOM.nextInt(FS_SCALE * 2) - FS_SCALE;
        }

        // Temp buffers
        final int[] diff = new int[3]; // No alpha
        final int[] inRGB = new int[4];
        final int[] outRGB = new int[4];
        Object pixel = null;
        boolean forward = true;

        // Loop through image data
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            // Clear out next error rows for colour errors
            for (int i = nextErr.length; --i >= 0;) {
                nextErr[i][0] = 0;
                nextErr[i][1] = 0;
                nextErr[i][2] = 0;
            }

            // Set up start column and limit
            int x;
            int limit;
            if (forward) {
                x = 0;
                limit = width;
            }
            else {
                x = width - 1;
                limit = -1;
            }

            // TODO: Use getPixels instead of getPixel for better performance?            

            // Loop over row
            while (true) {
                // Get RGB from original raster
                // DON'T KNOW IF THIS WILL WORK FOR ALL TYPES.
                pSource.getPixel(x, y, inRGB);

                // Get error for this pixel & add error to rgb
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    // Make a 28.4 FP number, add Error (with fraction),
                    // rounding and truncate to int
                    inRGB[i] = ((inRGB[i] << 4) + currErr[x + 1][i] + 0x08) >> 4;

                    // Clamp
                    if (inRGB[i] > 255) {
                        inRGB[i] = 255;
                    }
                    else if (inRGB[i] < 0) {
                        inRGB[i] = 0;
                    }
                }

                // Get pixel value...
                // It is VERY important that we are using a IndexColorModel that
                // support reverse color lookup for speed.
                pixel = pColorModel.getDataElements(toIntARGB(inRGB), pixel);

                // ...set it...
                pDest.setDataElements(x, y, pixel);

                // ..and get back the closet match
                pDest.getPixel(x, y, outRGB);

                // Convert the value to default sRGB
                // Should work for all transfertypes supported by IndexColorModel
                toRGBArray(pColorModel.getRGB(outRGB[0]), outRGB);

                // Find diff
                diff[0] = inRGB[0] - outRGB[0];
                diff[1] = inRGB[1] - outRGB[1];
                diff[2] = inRGB[2] - outRGB[2];

                // Apply F-S error diffusion
                // Serpentine scan: left-right
                if (forward) {
                    // Row 1 (y)
                    // Update error in this pixel (x + 1)
                    currErr[x + 2][0] += diff[0] * 7;
                    currErr[x + 2][1] += diff[1] * 7;
                    currErr[x + 2][2] += diff[2] * 7;

                    // Row 2 (y + 1)
                    // Update error in this pixel (x - 1)
                    nextErr[x][0] += diff[0] * 3;
                    nextErr[x][1] += diff[1] * 3;
                    nextErr[x][2] += diff[2] * 3;
                    // Update error in this pixel (x)
                    nextErr[x + 1][0] += diff[0] * 5;
                    nextErr[x + 1][1] += diff[1] * 5;
                    nextErr[x + 1][2] += diff[2] * 5;
                    // Update error in this pixel (x + 1)
                    // TODO: Consider calculating this using
                    // error term = error - sum(error terms 1, 2 and 3)
                    // See Computer Graphics (Foley et al.), p. 573
                    nextErr[x + 2][0] += diff[0]; // * 1;
                    nextErr[x + 2][1] += diff[1]; // * 1;
                    nextErr[x + 2][2] += diff[2]; // * 1;

                    // Next
                    x++;

                    // Done?
                    if (x >= limit) {
                        break;
                    }

                }
                else {
                    // Row 1 (y)
                    // Update error in this pixel (x - 1)
                    currErr[x][0] += diff[0] * 7;
                    currErr[x][1] += diff[1] * 7;
                    currErr[x][2] += diff[2] * 7;

                    // Row 2 (y + 1)
                    // Update error in this pixel (x + 1)
                    nextErr[x + 2][0] += diff[0] * 3;
                    nextErr[x + 2][1] += diff[1] * 3;
                    nextErr[x + 2][2] += diff[2] * 3;
                    // Update error in this pixel (x)
                    nextErr[x + 1][0] += diff[0] * 5;
                    nextErr[x + 1][1] += diff[1] * 5;
                    nextErr[x + 1][2] += diff[2] * 5;
                    // Update error in this pixel (x - 1)
                    // TODO: Consider calculating this using
                    // error term = error - sum(error terms 1, 2 and 3)
                    // See Computer Graphics (Foley et al.), p. 573
                    nextErr[x][0] += diff[0]; // * 1;
                    nextErr[x][1] += diff[1]; // * 1;
                    nextErr[x][2] += diff[2]; // * 1;

                    // Previous
                    x--;

                    // Done?
                    if (x <= limit) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Make next error info current for next iteration
            int[][] temperr;
            temperr = currErr;
            currErr = nextErr;
            nextErr = temperr;

            // Toggle direction
            if (alternateScans) {
                forward = !forward;
            }
        }

        return pDest;
    }
</target_code>

package com.twelvemonkeys.io;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.EOFException;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class Win32LnkParseTests {
    private static final byte[] LNK_MAGIC = {
            'L', 0x00, 0x00, 0x00
    };

    private static final byte[] LNK_GUID = {
            0x01, 0x14, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
            (byte) 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 'F'
    };

    private static final int FLAG_ITEM_ID_LIST = 0x01;
    private static final int FLAG_FILE_LOC_INFO = 0x02;
    private static final int FLAG_DESC_STRING = 0x04;
    private static final int FLAG_REL_PATH_STRING = 0x08;
    private static final int FLAG_WORKING_DIRECTORY = 0x10;
    private static final int FLAG_COMMAND_LINE_ARGS = 0x20;
    private static final int FLAG_ICON_FILENAME = 0x40;
    private static final int FLAG_ADDITIONAL_INFO = 0x80;

    @TempDir
    Path tempDir;

    @Test
    void parseReturnsInputWhenExtensionIsNotLowercaseLnk() throws IOException {
        File notALink = tempDir.resolve("ordinary.txt").toFile();
        File uppercaseLink = tempDir.resolve("UPPER.LNK").toFile();
        Files.write(uppercaseLink.toPath(), "this is not a shell link".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));

        assertSame(notALink, Win32Lnk.parse(notALink));
        assertSame(uppercaseLink, Win32Lnk.parse(uppercaseLink));
    }

    @Test
    void parseThrowsFileNotFoundForMissingLnk() {
        File missing = tempDir.resolve("missing.lnk").toFile();

        assertThrows(FileNotFoundException.class, () -> Win32Lnk.parse(missing));
    }

    @Test
    void parseThrowsEofForTruncatedHeader() throws IOException {
        File truncated = writeFile("truncated.lnk", new byte[]{'L', 0x00, 0x00});

        assertThrows(EOFException.class, () -> Win32Lnk.parse(truncated));
    }

    @Test
    void parseReturnsInputForUnrecognizedMagicOrGuid() throws IOException {
        byte[] wrongMagic = lnk(0);
        wrongMagic[0] = 'X';
        File wrongMagicLink = writeFile("wrong-magic.lnk", wrongMagic);

        byte[] wrongGuid = lnk(0);
        wrongGuid[4] = 0x00;
        File wrongGuidLink = writeFile("wrong-guid.lnk", wrongGuid);

        assertSame(wrongMagicLink, Win32Lnk.parse(wrongMagicLink));
        assertSame(wrongGuidLink, Win32Lnk.parse(wrongGuidLink));
    }

    @Test
    void parseReturnsInputForValidHeaderWithoutKnownOptionalSections() throws IOException {
        File link = writeFile("plain.lnk", lnk(0));

        assertSame(link, Win32Lnk.parse(link));
    }

    @Test
    void parseSkipsShellItemListAndDescriptionString() throws IOException {
        int flags = FLAG_ITEM_ID_LIST | FLAG_DESC_STRING | FLAG_WORKING_DIRECTORY
                | FLAG_ICON_FILENAME | FLAG_ADDITIONAL_INFO;
        byte[] payload = concatenate(
                shellItemList(new byte[]{0x1f, 0x50, 0x00, 0x00}),
                description("a description to skip")
        );
        File link = writeFile("optional-

    @Test
    void parseThrowsEofWhenOptionalSectionIsTruncated() throws IOException {
        File link = writeFile("truncated-relative.lnk", lnk(FLAG_REL_PATH_STRING));

        assertThrows(EOFException.class, () -> Win32Lnk.parse(link));

    private File writeFile(String name, byte[] contents) throws IOException {
        Path path = tempDir.resolve(name);
        Files.write(path, contents);
        return path.toFile();
    }

    private static byte[] lnk(int flags, byte[]... payloads) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        out.write(LNK_MAGIC);
        out.write(LNK_GUID);

        writeInt(out, flags);
        writeInt(out, 0); // File attributes; not interpreted by parse.
        out.write(new byte[48]); // Timestamps, file size, icon, show command, hotkey and reserved data.

        for (byte[] payload : payloads) {
            out.write(payload);
        }

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] shellItemList(byte[] itemData) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeShort(out, itemData.length);
        out.write(itemData);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] description(String description) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = description.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeShort(out, bytes.length);
        out.write(bytes);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] relativePath(String path) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = path.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeShort(out, bytes.length);
        out.write(bytes);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] fileLocationInfo(String targetPath) throws IOException {
        // The parser computes the string length as tableLen - localSysOff - 2.
        // Two terminating NUL bytes therefore delimit the path while keeping its
        // final character in the constructed result.
        byte[] pathBytes = targetPath.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        int localSysOff = 20;
        int tableLen = localSysOff + pathBytes.length + 2;

        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeInt(out, tableLen);
        writeInt(out, 0); // Pointer to first offset after the structure.
        writeInt(out, 0x01); // Available on local volume.
        writeInt(out, 0); // Local volume info offset.
        writeInt(out, localSysOff); // Local base pathname offset.
        out.write(pathBytes);
        out.write(0);
        out.write(0);

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] fileLocationInfoWithFollowingRelativePath(String targetPath, String relativePath)
            throws IOException {
        byte[] targetBytes = targetPath.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        byte[] relativeBytes = relativePath.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        int localSysOff = 20;
        int tableLen = localSysOff + targetBytes.length + 2;

        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeInt(out, tableLen);
        writeInt(out, 0);
        writeInt(out, 0x01);
        writeInt(out, 0);
        writeInt(out, localSysOff);
        out.write(targetBytes);
        out.write(0);
        // The parser leaves the last byte of the file location information
        // unread, so use it as the low byte of the following section's length.
        out.write(relativeBytes.length & 0xff);
        out.write((relativeBytes.length >>> 8) & 0xff);
        out.write(relativeBytes);

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] concatenate(byte[]... parts) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        for (byte[] part : parts) {
            out.write(part);
        }
        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static void writeShort(ByteArrayOutputStream out, int value) {
        out.write(value & 0xff);
        out.write((value >>> 8) & 0xff);
    }

    private static void writeInt(ByteArrayOutputStream out, int value) {
        out.write(value & 0xff);
        out.write((value >>> 8) & 0xff);
        out.write((value >>> 16) & 0xff);
        out.write((value >>> 24) & 0xff);
    }
}

package com.twelvemonkeys.lang;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertAll;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;

class BeanUtilGetPropertyValueTests {

    @Test
    void returnsNullForNullObjectOrUnusablePropertyName() {
        SimpleBean bean = new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true);

        assertAll(
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(null, "name")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, null)),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "   "))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void getsSimplePropertiesThroughTheirPublicGetters() {
        SimpleBean bean = new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true);

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("Ada", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "name")),
                () -> assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(42), BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "age")),
                () -> assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "active"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void capitalizesThePropertyNameWhenLookingUpTheGetter() {
        SimpleBean bean = new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true);

        assertEquals("Ada", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "Name"));
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullForUnknownPropertyAndMissingGetterConventions() {
        SimpleBean bean = new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true);

        assertAll(
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "missing")),
                // BeanUtil intentionally looks only for getXxx(), not isXxx().
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "enabled")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, ".name")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "name..age"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullWhenGetterReturnsNull() {
        assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true), "nullValue"));
    }

    @Test
    void supportsNestedProperties() {
        Person person = new Person("Ada", new Address("Main Street", new Details("12345")));

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("Main Street", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(person, "address.street")),
                () -> assertEquals("12345", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(person, "address.details.postalCode"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void traversesGettersOnJdkObjectsAndPrimitiveReturnValues() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertSame(String.class, BeanUtil.getPropertyValue("text", "class")),
                () -> assertEquals("java.lang.String", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue("text", "class.name"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullWhenAnIntermediatePropertyIsNull() {
        Person person = new Person("Ada", null);

        assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(person, "address.street"));
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullWhenAGetterThrowsAnException() {
        assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true), "explosive"));
    }

    @Test
    void supportsNumericBracketArgumentsAsIntGetters() {
        IndexedBean bean = new IndexedBean();

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("zero", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "element[0]")),
                () -> assertEquals("two", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "element[2]")),
                () -> assertEquals("int:-1", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "overloaded[-1]")),
                () -> assertEquals("int:12", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "overloaded[12]"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void supportsNonNumericBracketArgumentsAsLowercaseStringGetters() {
        IndexedBean bean = new IndexedBean();

        assertEquals("string:mixedcase", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "overloaded[MixedCase]"));
    }

    @Test
    void supportsBracketArgumentsInNestedPropertyPaths() {
        Family family = new Family();

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("Ada", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(family, "children[0].name")),
                () -> assertEquals("Second Street", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(family, "children[1].address.street"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullForMalformedOrImpossibleBracketArguments() {
        IndexedBean bean = new IndexedBean();

        assertAll(
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "element[0")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "[0]")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "overloaded[999999999999999999999]")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "element[99]")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "element[-1]"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullWhenBracketGetterThrows() {
        assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(new IndexedBean(), "explosive[1]"));
    }

    @Test
    void passesTheBracketArgumentToTheSelectedOverload() {
        OverloadedBean bean = new OverloadedBean();

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("int:3", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "lookup[3]")),
                () -> assertEquals("string:somekey", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "lookup[SomeKey]"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void getsAValueFromAStringKeyedBeanUsingTheLowercaseKey() {
        Map<String, String> values = new HashMap<String, String>();
        values.put("firstname", "Ada");
        StringMapBean bean = new StringMapBean(values);

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals("Ada", BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "value[FirstName]")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(bean, "value[Missing]"))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsNullRatherThanPropagatingGetterThrownExceptions() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true), "runtimeFailure")),
                () -> assertNull(BeanUtil.getPropertyValue(new SimpleBean("Ada", 42, true), "checkedFailure"))
        );
    }

    public static class SimpleBean {
        private final String name;
        private final int age;
        private final boolean active;
        private final String nullValue = null;

        public SimpleBean(String name, int age, boolean active) {
            this.name = name;
            this.age = age;
            this.active = active;
        }

        public String getName() {
            return name;
        }

        public int getAge() {
            return age;
        }

        public boolean getActive() {
            return active;
        }

        public String getNullValue() {
            return nullValue;
        }

        public boolean isEnabled() {
            return true;
        }

        public String getExplosive() {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No value available");
        }

        public String getRuntimeFailure() {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Runtime failure");
        }

        public String getCheckedFailure() throws Exception {
            throw new Exception("Checked failure");
        }
    }

    public static class Person {
        private final String name;
        private final Address address;

        public Person(String name, Address address) {
            this.name = name;
            this.address = address;
        }

        public String getName() {
            return name;
        }

        public Address getAddress() {
            return address;

        char firstU = Character.toUpperCase(pLookFor.charAt(0));
        int indexLower = 0;
        int indexUpper = 0;

        for (int i = pPos; i <= (pString.length() - pLookFor.length()); i++) {

            // Peek for first char
            indexLower = ((indexLower >= 0) && (indexLower <= i))
                    ? pString.indexOf(firstL, i)
                    : indexLower;
            indexUpper = ((indexUpper >= 0) && (indexUpper <= i))
                    ? pString.indexOf(firstU, i)
                    : indexUpper;
            if (indexLower < 0) {
                if (indexUpper < 0) {
                    return -1;// First char not found

                else {
                    i = indexUpper;// Only upper

            }
            else if (indexUpper < 0) {
                i = indexLower;// Only lower

            else {

    public static int indexOfIgnoreCase(String pString, String pLookFor, int pPos) {
        if ((pString == null) || (pLookFor == null)) {
            return -1;
        }
        if (pLookFor.length() == 0) {
            return pPos;// All strings "contains" the empty string
        }
        if (pLookFor.length() > pString.length()) {
            return -1;// Cannot contain string longer than itself
        }

        // Get first char
        char firstL = Character.toLowerCase(pLookFor.charAt(0));
        char firstU = Character.toUpperCase(pLookFor.charAt(0));
        int indexLower = 0;
        int indexUpper = 0;

        for (int i = pPos; i <= (pString.length() - pLookFor.length()); i++) {

            // Peek for first char
            indexLower = ((indexLower >= 0) && (indexLower <= i))
                    ? pString.indexOf(firstL, i)
                    : indexLower;
            indexUpper = ((indexUpper >= 0) && (indexUpper <= i))
                    ? pString.indexOf(firstU, i)
                    : indexUpper;
            if (indexLower < 0) {
                if (indexUpper < 0) {
                    return -1;// First char not found
                }
                else {
                    i = indexUpper;// Only upper
                }
            }
            else if (indexUpper < 0) {
                i = indexLower;// Only lower
            }
            else {

                // Both found, select first occurence
                i = (indexLower < indexUpper)
                        ? indexLower
                        : indexUpper;
            }

            // Only one?
            if (pLookFor.length() == 1) {
                return i;// The only char found!
            }

            // Test if we still have enough chars
            else if (i > (pString.length() - pLookFor.length())) {
                return -1;
            }

            // Test if last char equals! (regionMatches is expensive)
            else if ((pString.charAt(i + pLookFor.length() - 1) != Character.toLowerCase(pLookFor.charAt(pLookFor.length() - 1)))
                    && (pString.charAt(i + pLookFor.length() - 1) != Character.toUpperCase(pLookFor.charAt(pLookFor.length() - 1)))) {
                continue;// Nope, try next
            }

            // Test from second char, until second-last char
            else if ((pLookFor.length() <= 2) || pString.regionMatches(true, i + 1, pLookFor, 1, pLookFor.length() - 2)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index within this string of the rightmost occurrence of the
     * specified substring. The rightmost empty string "" is considered to
     * occur at the index value {@code pString.length() - 1}.
     *
     * @param pString  The string to test
     * @param pLookFor The string to look for
     * @return If the string argument occurs one or more times as a substring
     *         within this object at a starting index no greater than fromIndex, then
     *         the index of the first character of the last such substring is returned.
     *         If it does not occur as a substring starting at fromIndex or earlier, -1
     *         is returned.
     * @see String#lastIndexOf(String)
     */
    public static int lastIndexOfIgnoreCase(String pString, String pLookFor) {
        return lastIndexOfIgnoreCase(pString, pLookFor, pString != null ? pString.length() - 1 : -1);
    }

package com.twelvemonkeys.lang;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertAll;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class StringUtilIndexOfIgnoreCaseTests {

    @Test
    void nullStringReturnsMinusOne() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase(null, "a", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase(null, "", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase(null, null, 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase(null, "a", 5))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void nullLookForReturnsMinusOne() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", null, 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("", null, 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", null, 2)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase(null, null, 7))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void emptyLookForReturnsTheRequestedPosition() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "", 2)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "", 3)),
                () -> assertEquals(10, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "", 10))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void emptyStringsAreHandledConsistently() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("", "", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(4, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("", "", 4)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("", "a", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void lookForLongerThanStringReturnsMinusOne() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "abcd", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("a", "aa", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("a", "AA", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("", "a", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsIndexOfExactCaseSubstring() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("hello", "hello", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("hello", "ell", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(6, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("hello world", "world", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("start-middle-end", "art", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void findsMatchesIgnoringCaseAtVariousPositions() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello World", "hello", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(6, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello World", "WORLD", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(4, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("The Quick Brown Fox", "quick", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(10, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("The Quick Brown Fox", "bRoWn", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcXYZdef", "xyz", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(6, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("prefixSuffix", "suffix", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "ABC", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void returnsMinusOneWhenLookForIsAbsent() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "z", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "abd", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "xx", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "abcd", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void honorsStartPosition() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcabc", "abc", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcabc", "abc", 1)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcabc", "abc", 3)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcabc", "abc", 4)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("banana", "ana", 2)),
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aaaaa", "aa", 1)),
                () -> assertEquals(4, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aaaaa", "aa", 4))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void startPositionAfterLastPossibleMatchReturnsMinusOne() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "a", 4)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "abc", 4)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcXYZ", "XYZ", 3)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcXYZ", "XYZ", 4)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "c", Integer.MAX_VALUE))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void singleCharacterLookForSupportsBothCases() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello", "h", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello", "L", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(4, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello", "o", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Hello", "z", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abc", "A", 1)),
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aAa", "A", 1))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void singleCharacterLookForHandlesOnlyLowerOrOnlyUpperHaystackMatch() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("XYZ", "x", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("xyz", "X", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcXYZdef", "x", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(3, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abcxyzdef", "X", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void skipsCandidateWhoseLastCharacterDoesNotMatch() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aXaY", "AY", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("Axab", "ab", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aab", "AB", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("aaaaab", "aaab", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void skipsCandidateWhoseMiddleCharactersDoNotMatch() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(-1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abXd", "abcd", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(4, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abXdabcd", "abcd", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void comparesMiddleCharactersIgnoringCase() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("xAbCdY", "abcd", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("abCde", "ABCDE", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(2, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("xxaBcY", "ABC", 0))
        );
    }

    @Test
    void findsNonAsciiLettersIgnoringCase() {
        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(1, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("x\u00c9y", "\u00e9", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("CAF\u00c9", "caf\u00e9", 0)),
                () -> assertEquals(0, StringUtil.indexOfIgnoreCase("\u00c7a", "\u00e7A", 0))
        );
    }
}

public static int lastIndexOfIgnoreCase(String pString, String pLookFor, int pPos) {
        if ((pString == null) || (pLookFor == null)) {
            return -1;
        }
        if (pLookFor.length() == 0) {
            return pPos;// All strings "contains" the empty string
        }
        if (pLookFor.length() > pString.length()) {
            return -1;// Cannot contain string longer than itself
        }

        // Get first char
        char firstL = Character.toLowerCase(pLookFor.charAt(0));
        char firstU = Character.toUpperCase(pLookFor.charAt(0));
        int indexLower = pPos;
        int indexUpper = pPos;

        for (int i = pPos; i >= 0; i--) {

            // Peek for first char
            indexLower = ((indexLower >= 0) && (indexLower >= i))
                    ? pString.lastIndexOf(firstL, i)
                    : indexLower;
            indexUpper = ((indexUpper >= 0) && (indexUpper >= i))
                    ? pString.lastIndexOf(firstU, i)
                    : indexUpper;
            if (indexLower < 0) {
                if (indexUpper < 0) {
                    return -1;// First char not found
                }
                else {
                    i = indexUpper;// Only upper
                }
            }
            else if (indexUpper < 0) {
                i = indexLower;// Only lower
            }
            else {

                // Both found, select last occurence
                i = (indexLower > indexUpper)
                        ? indexLower
                        : indexUpper;
            }

            // Only one?
            if (pLookFor.length() == 1) {
                return i;// The only char found!
            }

            // Test if we still have enough chars
            else if (i > (pString.length() - pLookFor.length())) {
                //return -1;
                continue;
            }

            // Test if last char equals! (regionMatches is expensive)
            else
            if ((pString.charAt(i + pLookFor.length() - 1) != Character.toLowerCase(pLookFor.charAt(pLookFor.length() - 1)))

                continue;// Nope, try next
            }

            // Test from second char, until second-last char
            else
            if ((pLookFor.length() <= 2) || pString.regionMatches(true, i + 1, pLookFor, 1, pLookFor.length() - 2)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

                char previous = pString.charAt(i - 1);
                if (i == lastPos || Character.isUpperCase(previous)) {

                // Append word
                buf.append(pString.substring(lastPos, i).toLowerCase());

package com.twelvemonkeys.lang;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;

import java.util.stream.Stream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

@DisplayName("StringUtil.camelToLisp")
class StringUtilCamelToLispTests {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("null input is rejected")
    void nullInputThrowsIllegalArgumentException() {
        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(
                IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> StringUtil.camelToLisp(null)
        );

        assertEquals("string == null", exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("empty input is returned unchanged")
    void emptyInputIsReturnedUnchanged() {
        String input = "";

        assertSame(input, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("documentedExamples")
    @DisplayName("documented camel-case examples are converted")
    void convertsDocumentedExamples(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> documentedExamples() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("foo", "foo"),
                Arguments.of("fooBar", "foo-bar"),
                Arguments.of("myURL", "my-url"),
                Arguments.of("HttpRequestWrapper", "http-request-wrapper"),
                Arguments.of("HttpURLConnection", "http-url-connection"),
                Arguments.of("my45Caliber", "my-45-caliber"),
                Arguments.of("allready-lisp", "allready-lisp")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("singleCharacterInputs")
    @DisplayName("single-character inputs are handled")
    void convertsSingleCharacterInputs(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> singleCharacterInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("a", "a"),
                Arguments.of("A", "a"),
                Arguments.of("z", "z"),
                Arguments.of("Z", "z"),
                Arguments.of("7", "7")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("caseBoundaryInputs")
    @DisplayName("words are split at upper-case boundaries")
    void splitsWordsAtUpperCaseBoundaries(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> caseBoundaryInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("FooBar", "foo-bar"),
                Arguments.of("fooBAR", "foo-bar"),
                Arguments.of("XMLParser", "xml-parser"),
                Arguments.of("myXMLParser", "my-xml-parser"),
                Arguments.of("parseXML", "parse-xml"),
                Arguments.of("ABC", "abc"),
                Arguments.of("aBC", "a-bc"),
                Arguments.of("AbC", "ab-c"),
                Arguments.of("fOO", "f-oo")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("digitBoundaryInputs")
    @DisplayName("number sequences are separated from surrounding words")
    void separatesNumberSequences(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> digitBoundaryInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("foo123", "foo-123"),
                Arguments.of("foo1Bar", "foo-1-bar"),
                Arguments.of("foo123Bar", "foo-123-bar"),
                Arguments.of("foo123bar", "foo-123-bar"),
                Arguments.of("Foo123bar", "foo-123-bar"),
                Arguments.of("HTTP2Server", "http-2-server"),
                Arguments.of("ABC123Def", "abc-123-def"),
                Arguments.of("a12b", "a-12-b"),
                Arguments.of("a1B", "a-1b"),
                Arguments.of("123foo", "123-foo"),
                Arguments.of("9abc", "9abc")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("hyphenatedInputs")
    @DisplayName("existing hyphens are not duplicated")
    void doesNotDuplicateExistingHyphens(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> hyphenatedInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("hello-world", "hello-world"),
                Arguments.of("Hello-World", "hello-world"),
                Arguments.of("foo-Bar", "foo-bar"),
                Arguments.of("foo--Bar", "foo--bar"),
                Arguments.of("foo-barBaz", "foo-bar-baz"),
                Arguments.of("a1-B", "a-1-b"),
                Arguments.of("foo12-bar", "foo-12-bar")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("nonLetterInputs")
    @DisplayName("non-letter characters are preserved")
    void preservesOtherCharacters(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> nonLetterInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("all_lower", "all_lower"),
                Arguments.of("foo_barBaz", "foo_bar-baz"),
                Arguments.of("foo.barBaz", "foo.bar-baz"),
                Arguments.of("foo barBaz", "foo bar-baz"),
                Arguments.of(" ", " ")
        );
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] \"{0}\" -> \"{1}\"")
    @MethodSource("unicodeInputs")
    @DisplayName("Unicode upper-case characters are detected and lower-cased")
    void handlesUnicodeUpperCaseCharacters(String input, String expected) {
        assertEquals(expected, StringUtil.camelToLisp(input));
    }

    static Stream<Arguments> unicodeInputs() {
        return Stream.of(
                Arguments.of("\u00C9Foo", "\u00E9-foo"),
                Arguments.of("\u00E9Foo", "\u00E9-foo"),
                Arguments.of("foo\u00C9bar", "foo\u00E9-bar")
        );
    }
}

    @SuppressWarnings({"SuspiciousSystemArraycopy"})
    public static Object clone(final Cloneable pObject) throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        if (pObject == null) {
            return null; // Null is clonable.. Easy. ;-)
        }

        // All arrays does have a clone method, but it's invisible for reflection...
        // By luck, multi-dimensional primitive arrays are instances of Object[]
        if (pObject instanceof Object[]) {
            return ((Object[]) pObject).clone();
        }
        else if (pObject.getClass().isArray()) {
            // One-dimensional primitive array, cloned manually
            int lenght = Array.getLength(pObject);
            Object clone = Array.newInstance(pObject.getClass().getComponentType(), lenght);
            System.arraycopy(pObject, 0, clone, 0, lenght);
            return clone;
        }

        try {
            // Find the clone method
            Method clone = null;
            Class clazz = pObject.getClass();
            do {
                try {
                    clone = clazz.getDeclaredMethod("clone");
                    break; // Found, or throws exception above
                }
                catch (NoSuchMethodException ignore) {
                    // Ignore
                }
            }
            while ((clazz = clazz.getSuperclass()) != null);

            // NOTE: This should never happen
            if (clone == null) {
                throw new CloneNotSupportedException(pObject.getClass().getName());
            }

            // Override access if needed
            if (!clone.isAccessible()) {
                clone.setAccessible(true);
            }

            // Invoke clone method on original object
            return clone.invoke(pObject);
        }
        catch (SecurityException e) {
            CloneNotSupportedException cns = new CloneNotSupportedException(pObject.getClass().getName());
            cns.initCause(e);
            throw cns;
        }
        catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
            throw new CloneNotSupportedException(pObject.getClass().getName());
        }
        catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
            if (e.getTargetException() instanceof CloneNotSupportedException) {
                throw (CloneNotSupportedException) e.getTargetException();
            }
            else if (e.getTargetException() instanceof RuntimeException) {
                throw (RuntimeException) e.getTargetException();
            }
            else if (e.getTargetException() instanceof Error) {
                throw (Error) e.getTargetException();
            }

public static BufferedImage applyOrientation(BufferedImage input, int orientation) {
        boolean flipExtends = false;
        int w = input.getWidth();
        int h = input.getHeight();
        double cW = w / 2.0;
        double cH = h / 2.0;

        AffineTransform orientationTransform = new AffineTransform();
        switch (orientation) {
            case TIFFBaseline.ORIENTATION_TOPLEFT:
                // normal
                return input;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_TOPRIGHT:
                // flipped vertically
                orientationTransform.translate(cW, cH);
                orientationTransform.scale(-1, 1);
                orientationTransform.translate(-cW, -cH);
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_BOTRIGHT:
                // rotated 180
                orientationTransform.quadrantRotate(2, cW, cH);
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_BOTLEFT:
                // flipped horizontally
                orientationTransform.translate(cW, cH);
                orientationTransform.scale(1, -1);
                orientationTransform.translate(-cW, -cH);
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_LEFTTOP:
                orientationTransform.translate(cW, cH);
                orientationTransform.scale(-1, 1);
                orientationTransform.quadrantRotate(1);
                orientationTransform.translate(-cW, -cH);
                flipExtends = true;
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_RIGHTTOP:
                // rotated 90
                orientationTransform.quadrantRotate(1, cW, cH);
                flipExtends = true;
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_RIGHTBOT:
                orientationTransform.translate(cW, cH);
                orientationTransform.scale(1, -1);
                orientationTransform.quadrantRotate(1);
                orientationTransform.translate(-cW, -cH);
                flipExtends = true;
                break;
            case TIFFExtension.ORIENTATION_LEFTBOT:
                // rotated 270
                orientationTransform.quadrantRotate(3, cW, cH);
                flipExtends = true;
                break;
        }

        int newW, newH;
        if (flipExtends) {
            newW = h;
            newH = w;
        }
        else {
            newW = w;
            newH = h;
        }

        AffineTransform transform = AffineTransform.getTranslateInstance((newW - w) / 2.0, (newH - h) / 2.0);
        transform.concatenate(orientationTransform);
        AffineTransformOp transformOp = new AffineTransformOp(transform, null);
        return transformOp.filter(input, null);
    }

    static long defaultMaxImageBytes() {
        // Best-effort default for inputs of unknown length (e.g. streamed input, whose length is not known).
        // Bounded by an absolute cap so it does not scale with the heap: on a large-heap server, half the heap
        // would let a tiny streamed input drive a multi-gigabyte transient allocation. Floored at 64 MB so a
        // modest image still decodes on a tiny heap.
        long maxHeap = Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory();

        long cap = 512L * 1024 * 1024;
        long floor = 64L * 1024 * 1024;

        return Math.max(floor, Math.min(cap, maxHeap / 2));
    }

    private static long saturatedMultiply(final long a, final long b) {
        if (a <= 0 || b <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return a > Long.MAX_VALUE / b ? Long.MAX_VALUE : a * b;
    }

    protected DIBHeader() {
    }

    public static DIBHeader read(final DataInput stream) throws IOException {
        int size = stream.readInt();

        DIBHeader header = createHeader(size);
        header.read(size, stream);

        return header;
    }

    private static DIBHeader createHeader(final int size) throws IOException {
        switch (size) {
            case DIB.BITMAP_CORE_HEADER_SIZE:
                return new BitmapCoreHeader();
            case DIB.OS2_V2_HEADER_16_SIZE:
            case DIB.OS2_V2_HEADER_SIZE:
                return new BitmapCoreHeaderV2();
            case DIB.BITMAP_INFO_HEADER_SIZE:
            case DIB.BITMAP_V2_INFO_HEADER_SIZE:
            case DIB.BITMAP_V3_INFO_HEADER_SIZE:
                // ICO and CUR always uses the Microsoft Windows 3.0 DIB header, which is 40 bytes.
                // This is also the most common format for persistent BMPs.
                return new BitmapInfoHeader();
            case DIB.BITMAP_V4_INFO_HEADER_SIZE:
                return new BitmapV4InfoHeader();
            case DIB.BITMAP_V5_INFO_HEADER_SIZE:
                return new BitmapV5InfoHeader();
            default:
                throw new IIOException(String.format("Unknown Bitmap Information Header (size: %s)", size));
        }
    }

    protected abstract void read(int size, DataInput stream) throws IOException;
    protected abstract void write(final DataOutput stream) throws IOException;

    public final int getSize() {
        return size;
    }

    private void readHeader() throws IOException {
        assertInput();

        if (header == null) {
            // BMP files have Intel origin, always little endian
            imageInput.setByteOrder(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);

            // Read BMP file header
            byte[] fileHeader = new byte[DIB.BMP_FILE_HEADER_SIZE - 4]; // We'll read the last 4 bytes later
            imageInput.readFully(fileHeader);

            if (fileHeader[0] != 'B' || fileHeader[1] != 'M') {
                throw new IIOException("Not a BMP");
            }

            // Ignore rest of data, it's redundant...
            pixelOffset = imageInput.readUnsignedInt();

            // Read DIB header
            header = DIBHeader.read(imageInput);
//            System.out.println("header = " + header);

            if (pixelOffset < header.size + DIB.BMP_FILE_HEADER_SIZE) {
                throw new IIOException("Invalid pixel offset: " + pixelOffset);
            }
        }
    }

public final class ByteArrayImageInputStream extends ImageInputStreamImpl {
    private final byte[] data;
    private final int dataOffset;
    private final int dataLength;

    public ByteArrayImageInputStream(final byte[] data) {
        this(data, 0, data != null ? data.length : -1);
    }

    public ByteArrayImageInputStream(final byte[] data, int offset, int length) {
        this.data = notNull(data, "data");
        dataOffset = isMax(data.length, offset, "offset");
        dataLength = isMax(data.length - offset, length, "length");
    }

    private static int isMax(final int high, final int value, final String name) {
        return isTrue(value >= 0 && value <= high, value, String.format("%s out of range [0, %d]: %d", name, high, value));
    }

    public int read() throws IOException {
        if (streamPos >= dataLength) {
            return -1;
        }

        bitOffset = 0;

        return data[((int) streamPos++) + dataOffset] & 0xff;
    }

    public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int len) throws IOException {
        if (streamPos >= dataLength) {
            return -1;
        }

        int length = (int) Math.min(dataLength - streamPos, len);
        bitOffset = 0;
        System.arraycopy(data, (int) streamPos + dataOffset, buffer, offset, length);
        streamPos += length;

        return length;
    }

    @Override
    public long length() {
        return dataLength;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isCached() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * A DXT2/DXT3 style block where the alpha nibbles of row 0 are 15, 0, 0 and 8.
     * All other alpha nibbles are 0. Colors are white ({@code 0xFFFF}) and black ({@code 0x0000}),
     * and all color indices are 0 (that is, color0).
     */
    private static byte[] dxt3StyleBlock() {
        byte[] data = new byte[16];
        data[0] = (byte) 0xF0; // alpha values 15 and 0 for row 0
        data[1] = 0x08;        // alpha values 0 and 8 for row 0
        data[8] = (byte) 0xFF;
        data[9] = (byte) 0xFF; // color0 = white, color1 = black, all color indices 0

        return data;
    }

    /**
     * A DXT4/DXT5 style block where a0 = 255, a1 = 0, and the alpha indices of row 0 are 0, 1, 2 and 3.
     * All other alpha indices are 0. Colors are white ({@code 0xFFFF}) and black ({@code 0x0000}),
     * and all color indices are 0 (that is, color0).
     */
    private static byte[] dxt5StyleBlock() {
        byte[] data = new byte[16];
        data[0] = (byte) 0xFF; // a0
        data[1] = 0x00;        // a1

        int bits = 0 | (1 << 3) | (2 << 6) | (3 << 9);
        data[2] = (byte) (bits & 0xFF);
        data[3] = (byte) ((bits >> 8) & 0xFF);
        data[4] = (byte) ((bits >> 16) & 0xFF);

        data[8] = (byte) 0xFF;
        data[9] = (byte) 0xFF;

        return data;
    }

    private static DDSReader readerFor(DDSType type, int width, int height) throws IOException {
        return readerFor(type, width, height, 1);

    private static DDSReader readerFor(DDSType type, int width, int height, int mipMapCount) throws IOException {
        ByteBuffer header = headerBuffer(width, height, mipMapCount);

        if (type.isFourCC()) {
            header.putInt(DDS.PIXEL_FORMAT_FLAG_FOURCC);
            header.putInt(type.fourCC());
            header.putInt(0); // bit count
            header.putInt(0).putInt(0).putInt(0).putInt(0); // channel masks
        }
        else {
            int[] masks = type.rgbaMasks;
            int pixelFormatFlags = DDS.PIXEL_FORMAT_FLAG_RGB;
            if (masks[3] != 0) {
                pixelFormatFlags |= DDS.PIXEL_FORMAT_FLAG_ALPHAPIXELS;
            }

            header.putInt(pixelFormatFlags);
            header.putInt(0); // fourCC
            header.putInt(8 * type.blockSize()); // bit count == bits per pixel for uncompressed types
            header.putInt(masks[0]).putInt(masks[1]).putInt(masks[2]).putInt(masks[3]);
        }

        putCaps(header);

        return new DDSReader(DDSHeader.read(headerInput(header)));

package com.twelvemonkeys.imageio.plugins.hdr;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.DataInput;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Tests for {@code RGBE.readHeader(DataInput)}.
 */
public class RGBEReadHeaderTests {

    private static final String FORMAT = "FORMAT=32-bit_rle_rgbe";

    // --- helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static DataInput lines(final String... lines) {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (String line : lines) {
            builder.append(line).append('\n');
        }

        return stream(builder.toString());
    }

    private static DataInput stream(final String content) {
        return new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1)));
    }

    // --- normal cases --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    public void testMinimalHeaderUsesDefaults() throws IOException {
        RGBE.Header header = RGBE.readHeader(lines(FORMAT, "-Y 10 +X 20"));

        assertNotNull(header);
        assertEquals(20, header.getWidth());
        assertEquals(10, header.getHeight());
        assertEquals(1.0f, header.getGamma(), 0.0f);
        assertEquals(1.0f, header.getExposure(), 0.0f);
        assertNull(header.getProgramType());
        assertFalse(header.isProgramTypeValid());
        assertFalse(header.isGammaValid());
        assertFalse(header.isExposureValid());
    }

    @Test
    public void testFullyPopulatedHeader() throws IOException {
        RGBE.Header header = RGBE.readHeader(lines(
                "#?RGBE",
                "GAMMA=2.2",
                "EXPOSURE=1.5",
                FORMAT,
                "-Y 512 +X 1024"
        ));

        assertTrue(header.isProgramTypeValid());

    public WritableRaster filter(Raster src, WritableRaster dest) {

                    "only 3 or 4 byte TYPE_BYTE or 1 int TYPE_INT rasters supported as dest: %s"
            );
        }

        final int height = src.getHeight();
        final int width = src.getWidth();

        final byte[] in = new byte[src.getNumDataElements()]; // CMYK

        if (dest.getTransferType() == DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE) {
            final byte[] out = new byte[dest.getNumDataElements()];

            if (out.length > 3) {
                out[3] = (byte) 0xFF;
            }

            for (int y = dest.getMinY(); y < height; y++) {
                for (int x = dest.getMinX(); x < width; x++) {
                    src.getDataElements(x, y, in);
                    convertCMYKToRGB(in, out);
                    dest.setDataElements(x, y, out);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (dest.getTransferType() == DataBuffer.TYPE_INT) {
            final int[] out = new int[dest.getNumDataElements()];
            final byte[] temp = new byte[3]; // RGB

            // Special case for INT_BGR types, as bit offsets are not handled in setDataElements like for the byte raster case
            int[] bitOffsets;
            SampleModel sm = dest.getSampleModel();
            if (sm instanceof SinglePixelPackedSampleModel) {
                bitOffsets = ((SinglePixelPackedSampleModel) sm).getBitOffsets();
            }
            else {
                bitOffsets = new int[]{0, 8, 16};
            }

            final int alpha = bitOffsets.length > 3 ? 0xFF : 0x00;

            for (int y = dest.getMinY(); y < height; y++) {
                for (int x = dest.getMinX(); x < width; x++) {
                    src.getDataElements(x, y, in);
                    convertCMYKToRGB(in, temp);
                    out[0] = alpha << 24 | (temp[0] & 0xFF) << bitOffsets[0] | (temp[1] & 0xFF) << bitOffsets[1] | (temp[2] & 0xFF) << bitOffsets[2];

        }

    <artifactId>imageio-jpeg</artifactId>
    <name>TwelveMonkeys » ImageIO » JPEG plugin</name>

    </description>

    <properties>
        <project.jpms.module.name>com.twelvemonkeys.imageio.jpeg</project.jpms.module.name>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.twelvemonkeys.imageio</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.twelvemonkeys.imageio</groupId>
            <artifactId>imageio-core</artifactId>
            <type>test-jar</type>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.twelvemonkeys.imageio</groupId>
            <artifactId>imageio-metadata</artifactId>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.felix</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-bundle-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <instructions>
                        <Provide-Capability>
                            osgi.serviceloader;
                            osgi.serviceloader=javax.imageio.spi.ImageReaderSpi,
                            osgi.serviceloader;
                            osgi.serviceloader=javax.imageio.spi.ImageWriterSpi
                        </Provide-Capability>
                    </instructions>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

Now design tests. Target is package-private class FastCMYKToRGB. Test in same package.

Need to test filter behavior:
- null src -> IllegalArgumentException message "src may not be null".
- src == dest -> IllegalArgumentException.
- src transfer type not TYPE_BYTE (e.g. TYPE_USHORT, TYPE_INT) -> IllegalArgumentException with message containing "only TYPE_BYTE rasters supported as src" and src.toString perhaps.
- src num data elements < 4 -> IllegalArgumentException "CMYK raster must have at least 4 data elements: N".
- dest null -> created compatible dest. Source CMYK raster of width,height, 4 bands. createCompatibleDestRaster: src.createCompatibleWritableRaster().createWritableChild(... bands {0,1,2}) returns a WritableRaster with 3 bands? Let's check type of destination; likely TYPE_BYTE due to source? If source is 4-band byte CMYK, compatible raster likely 4-band, then child of bands 0,1,2. That gives 3 bands. We can assert pixel RGB values and return non-null, dest != src, maybe getNumBands=3, transfer type byte. Need compute expected values with known conversion.

Conversion formula: each channel: 255 - ((c*(255-k)/255)+k) integer division. Test values:
- CMYK (0,0,0,0) -> white (255,255,255)
- (0,0,0,255) -> black (0,0,0)
- (255,0,0,0) -> cyan ink full -> R=0, G=255, B=255. Formula R=255 - (255*255/255 + 0)=0; G = 255 - 0 =255; B=255.
- (0,255,0,0) -> (255,0,255)
- (0,0,255,0) -> (255,255,0)
- arbitrary e.g. c=10,y=20? Let's compute property perhaps avoid reproducing algorithm expected values? Requirement says no expected values that reproduce production algorithm. But simple known values from CMYK conversion are okay (black, white, primaries, 50% values). We can assert specific expected.

Use custom Raster construction. Could use BufferedImage with ComponentColorModel? Simpler: create a WritableRaster with BandedSampleModel or PixelInterleavedSampleModel.

For source: `Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, width, height, 4, new Point(0,0))` returns WritableRaster with PixelInterleavedSampleModel, 4 data elements. Set samples. Or `Raster.createBandedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, width, height, 4, null)` maybe getNumDataElements? For banded, getNumDataElements maybe 1?     @Test
    public void sourceWithTooFewDataElementsIsRejected() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(3, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0});

        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(
                IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> op.filter(src, null)
        );

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("at least 4 data elements"),
                "Unexpected message: " + exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    public void invalidDestinationTransferTypeIsRejected() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_USHORT, 1, 1, 3, new Point(0, 0));

        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(
                IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> op.filter(src, dest)
        );

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("only 3 or 4 byte TYPE_BYTE or 1 int TYPE_INT rasters supported as dest"),
                "Unexpected message: " + exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    public void byteDestinationWithTooFewDataElementsIsRejected() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 1, 1, 2, new Point(0, 0));

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> op.filter(src, dest));
    }

    @Test
    public void intDestinationWithMoreThanOneDataElementIsRejected() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = createIntInterleavedRaster(2, 1, 1);

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> op.filter(src, dest));
    }

    // --- Byte destination -------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    public void convertsToThreeByteRgbDestination() {
        // 2x2 image: white, black, cyan (C=255), and 50% black (K=128).
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 2, 2,
                new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0},
                new int[]{0, 0, 0, 255},
                new int[]{255, 0, 0, 0},
                new int[]{0, 0, 0, 128}
        );
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 2, 2, 3, new Point(0, 0));

        WritableRaster result = op.filter(src, dest);

        assertSame(dest, result);
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0));
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 0, 0}, pixel(dest, 1, 0));
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 1));
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{127, 127, 127}, pixel(dest, 1, 1));
    }

    @Test
    public void convertsPrimaryInksToRgb() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 3, 1,
                new int[]{255, 0, 0, 0},
                new int[]{0, 255, 0, 0},
                new int[]{0, 0, 255, 0}
        );
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 3, 1, 3, new Point(0, 0));

        op.filter(src, dest);

        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0)); // Cyan ink removes red
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 0, 255}, pixel(dest, 1, 0)); // Magenta ink removes green
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 255, 0}, pixel(dest, 2, 0)); // Yellow ink removes blue
    }

    @Test
    public void fourByteDestinationGetsOpaqueAlpha() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 1, 1, 4, new Point(0, 0));

        op.filter(src, dest);

        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 255, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0));
    }

    @Test
    public void destinationWithMoreThanFourDataElementsIsAcceptedAndFourthIsOpaque() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 255});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 1, 1, 5, new Point(0, 0));

        WritableRaster result = op.filter(src, dest);

        assertSame(dest, result);
        int[] out = new int[5];
        dest.getPixel(0, 0, out);
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 0, 0}, new int[]{out[0], out[1], out[2]});
        assertEquals(255, out[3], "Fourth element should be forced opaque");
    }

    @Test
    public void extraSourceDataElementsAreIgnored() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(5, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0, 123});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, 1, 1, 3, new Point(0, 0));

        op.filter(src, dest);

        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0));
    }

    @Test
    public void nullDestinationCreatesRgbCompatibleRaster() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 2, 1,
                new int[]{0, 0, 0, 255},
                new int[]{255, 0, 0, 0}
        );

        WritableRaster result = op.filter(src, null);

        assertNotSame(src, result);
        assertEquals(2, result.getWidth());
        assertEquals(1, result.getHeight());
        assertEquals(3, result.getNumBands());
        assertEquals(DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, result.getTransferType());
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 0, 0}, pixel(result, 0, 0));
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 255, 255}, pixel(result, 1, 0));
    }

    // --- INT destination --------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    public void convertsToPackedIntRgbDestination() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 2, 1,
                new int[]{255, 0, 0, 0},
                new int[]{0, 0, 0, 255}
        );
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createPackedRaster(
                DataBuffer.TYPE_INT, 2, 1, new int[]{0xFF0000, 0x00FF00, 0x0000FF}, null
        );

        WritableRaster result = op.filter(src, dest);

        assertSame(dest, result);
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0));
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{0, 0, 0}, pixel(dest, 1, 0));
    }

    @Test
    public void fourBandPackedIntDestinationGetsOpaqueAlpha() {
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createPackedRaster(
                DataBuffer.TYPE_INT, 1, 1,
                new int[]{0x00FF0000, 0x0000FF00, 0x000000FF, 0xFF000000}, null
        );

        op.filter(src, dest);

        // The fourth bit offset is the alpha channel, which must be opaque.
        assertArrayEquals(new int[]{255, 255, 255, 255}, pixel(dest, 0, 0));
    }

    @Test
    public void convertsToIntDestinationWithoutSinglePixelPackedSampleModel() {
        // A single-band INT raster does not use SinglePixelPackedSampleModel.
        // The fallback bit offsets are {0, 8, 16}, resulting in 0x00BBGGRR.
        WritableRaster src = createByteRaster(4, 1, 1, new int[]{0, 0, 0, 0});
        WritableRaster dest = Raster.createBandedRaster(DataBuffer.TYPE_INT, 1, 1, 1, null);

        op.filter(src, dest);

        int expected = 0x00FFFFFF; // R=255, G=255, B=255 at bits 0, 8 and 16
        assertEquals(expected, dest.getSample(0, 0, 0));
    }

    // --- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------

    private static int[] pixel(WritableRaster raster, int x, int y) {
        int[] pixel = new int[raster.getNumBands()];
        raster.getPixel(x, y, pixel);
        return pixel;
    }

    private static WritableRaster createIntInterleavedRaster(int bands, int width, int height) {
        int[] bandOffsets = new int[bands];
        for (int i = 0; i < bands; i++) {
            bandOffsets[i] = i;
        }

        SampleModel sampleModel = new PixelInterleavedSampleModel(
                DataBuffer.TYPE_INT, width, height, bands, width * bands, bandOffsets
        );

        return Raster.createWritableRaster(sampleModel, new DataBufferInt(width * height * bands), new Point(0, 0));
    }

    private static WritableRaster createByteRaster(int bands, int width, int height, int[]... pixels) {
        WritableRaster raster = Raster.createInterleavedRaster(
                DataBuffer.TYPE_BYTE, width, height, bands, new Point(0, 0)
        );

        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                raster.setPixel(x, y, pixels[y * width + x]);
            }
        }

        return raster;
    }
}

ICC_Profile getEmbeddedICCProfile(final boolean allowBadIndexes) throws IOException {
        // ICC v 1.42 (2006) annex B:
        // APP2 marker (0xFFE2) + 2 byte length + ASCII 'ICC_PROFILE' + 0 (termination)
        // + 1 byte chunk number + 1 byte chunk count (allows ICC profiles chunked in multiple APP2 segments)

        // TODO: Allow metadata to contain the wrongly indexed profiles, if readable
        // NOTE: We ignore any profile with wrong index for reading and image types, just to be on the safe side

        List<Application> segments = getAppSegments(JPEG.APP2, "ICC_PROFILE");

        // TODO: Possibly move this logic to the ICCProfile class...

        if (segments.size() == 1) {
            // Faster code for the common case
            Application segment = segments.get(0);
            DataInputStream stream = new DataInputStream(segment.data());
            int chunkNumber = stream.readUnsignedByte();
            int chunkCount = stream.readUnsignedByte();

            if (chunkNumber != 1 && chunkCount != 1) {
                processWarningOccurred(String.format("Unexpected number of 'ICC_PROFILE' chunks: %d of %d. Ignoring ICC profile.", chunkNumber, chunkCount));
                return null;
            }

            return readICCProfileSafe(stream, allowBadIndexes);
        }
        else if (!segments.isEmpty()) {
            // NOTE: This is probably over-complicated, as I've never encountered ICC_PROFILE chunks out of order...
            DataInputStream stream = new DataInputStream(segments.get(0).data());
            int chunkNumber = stream.readUnsignedByte();
            int chunkCount = stream.readUnsignedByte();

            // TODO: Most of the time the ICC profiles are readable and should be obtainable from metadata...
            boolean badICC = false;
            if (chunkCount != segments.size()) {
                // Some weird JPEGs use 0-based indexes... count == 0 and all numbers == 0.
                // Others use count == 1, and all numbers == 1.
                // Handle these by issuing warning
                processWarningOccurred(String.format("Bad 'ICC_PROFILE' chunk count: %d. Ignoring ICC profile.", chunkCount));
                badICC = true;

                if (!allowBadIndexes) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            int count = badICC ? segments.size() : chunkCount;

            if (!badICC && (chunkNumber < 1 || chunkNumber > count)) {
                // Anything else is just ignored
                processWarningOccurred(String.format("Invalid 'ICC_PROFILE' chunk index: %d of %d. Ignoring ICC profile.", chunkNumber, chunkCount));

                return null;
            }

            InputStream[] streams = new InputStream[count];
            streams[badICC ? 0 : chunkNumber - 1] = stream;

            for (int i = 1; i < count; i++) {
                Application segment = segments.get(i);
                stream = new DataInputStream(segment.data());

                chunkNumber = stream.readUnsignedByte();

                if (stream.readUnsignedByte() != chunkCount && !badICC) {
                    throw new IIOException(String.format("Bad number of 'ICC_PROFILE' chunks: %d of %d.", chunkNumber, chunkCount));
                }

                int index = badICC ? i : chunkNumber - 1;
                if (index < 0 || index >= count) {
                    processWarningOccurred(String.format("Invalid 'ICC_PROFILE' chunk index: %d of %d. Ignoring ICC profile.", chunkNumber, chunkCount));

                    return null;
                }

                streams[index] = stream;
            }

            return readICCProfileSafe(new SequenceInputStream(Collections.enumeration(Arrays.asList(streams))), allowBadIndexes);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static JPEGImageReader createJPEGImageReader() {
        Iterator<ImageReader> readers = ImageIO.getImageReadersByFormatName("JPEG");

        while (readers.hasNext()) {
            ImageReader candidate = readers.next();
            if (candidate instanceof JPEGImageReader) {
                return (JPEGImageReader) candidate;

            candidate.dispose();

    /**
     * Creates a minimal JPEG stream (SOI, the given APP2 segment payloads, EOI).
     * The stream is syntactically valid for segment scanning, which is all the method under test needs.
     */
    private static byte[] jpeg(byte[]... app2SegmentPayloads) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        out.write(0xff);
        out.write(0xd8); // SOI

        for (byte[] payload : app2SegmentPayloads) {
            out.write(0xff);
            out.write(0xe2); // APP2
            int length = payload.length + 2; // Length includes the length field itself
            if (length > 0xffff) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("APP2 segment too long: " + length);
            }
            out.write(length >> 8 & 0xff);
            out.write(length & 0xff);
            out.write(payload);
        }

        out.write(0xff);
        out.write(0xd9); // EOI

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] iccSegment(int chunkNumber, int chunkCount, byte[] data) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        out.write(ICC_IDENTIFIER.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
        out.write(0); // Identifier is null terminated
        out.write(chunkNumber & 0xff);
        out.write(chunkCount & 0xff);
        out.write(data);

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] app2Segment(String identifier, byte[] data) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        out.write(identifier.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
        out.write(0);
        out.write(data);

        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[][] split(byte[] data, int parts) {
        byte[][] result = new byte[parts][];
        int chunkSize = data.length / parts;
        int offset = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
            int length = i < parts - 1 ? chunkSize : data.length - offset;
            result[i] = Arrays.copyOfRange(data, offset, offset + length);
            offset += length;
        }

        return result;
    }
